tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Hill-fog green-white in Mist, tea-estate night in Night estate. Every page starts here.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered ledger rows and screenshot mats. Never a card fill or a form-field fill: Terrace has no cards, and fields are lines.

tokens.name: ground-sunk
tokens.usage: The metadata strip band under the masthead and inline code. Text on it uses ink, ink-muted, muscatel-text, leaf or train (all 4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules only: ledger row dividers, terrace lines in the masthead, table lines. Below 3:1 by design, so it never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: form-row lines, secondary button outline, status pill outline, rule terminal crosses. 3.2:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on ground, ground-raised and ground-sunk (12.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata values, captions, ledger descriptions, bracket marks around labels. 5.4:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: estate
tokens.usage: Deep tea-estate green. The one inverted band per page (contact and footer), the primary button fill, the favicon ground.

tokens.name: estate-line
tokens.usage: Decorative terrace lines drawn on the estate band. Never text.

tokens.name: on-estate
tokens.usage: Text, icons and focus rings on estate (10:1).

tokens.name: on-estate-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on estate: footer metadata, field labels in the contact band (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: muscatel
tokens.usage: Second-flush amber, the only accent. A mark color: the open-to-work dot, link underlines, active nav underline, focus ring on ground. 3.5:1 or better on every ground. In Mist it never carries text and never sits behind text.

tokens.name: muscatel-text
tokens.usage: Amber text on ground, ground-raised and ground-sunk: the local clock, the word 'now' in the experience log, hovered links (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: muscatel-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind ink text, used once per page at most (for example the selected-text color). Ink on it is 10:1 or better.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Status: Live. Dot and word together, never the dot alone. 4.9:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: train
tokens.usage: Status: In progress. Named for the blue Darjeeling Himalayan Railway engines. Dot and word together. 6.3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on ground: 2px solid, 3px offset. Inside the estate band use on-estate instead, because muscatel is 2.7:1 on estate in Mist.

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: The name, once per site, uppercase, as wide as the content column. Scale with clamp(64px, 15.5vw, 200px).

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Project names in the ledger, uppercase.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Stencil marks only: the SM monogram and the seal. Never for words a reader must read.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build products where the software solves a real problem.
styles.usage: The role line under the masthead, the first paragraph of About, case-study taglines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Over the past 3 years, I have been working with TypeScript, React and Node.js.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines at 60 to 72 characters (layout token measure).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Roles in the experience log and inline emphasis.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: How Alias finds a hiring manager

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Autonomous job application pipeline for developers.
styles.usage: Ledger descriptions, figure captions in prose, form help text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bracket labels, nav links, button text, field labels. Uppercase, font-variation-settings 'wdth' 75.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The metadata strip, footer fine print, figure numbers. Uppercase, 'wdth' 75.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Years, periods and stack lists in the ledger and log. Tabular figures, 'wdth' 87.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in case studies, 'wdth' 100.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside labels and pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between metadata items; pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; gap between label and heading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; ledger cell gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Ledger row vertical padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between rail and content column; paragraph groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside a section between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop; estate band vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The default. Buttons, fields, screenshot frames, bands: Terrace is square-cut like a tea chest.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inline code and keyboard keys only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and status dots. The only round thing on the page, so status reads at a glance.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and ledger dividers, in hairline color.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Field underlines, secondary button outline, status pill outline, in rule color.

tokens.name: border-stamp
tokens.usage: The monogram and seal frames only.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Left rail for bracket labels on desktop (900px and wider). Collapses above the content on phones.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text (about 68 characters of body).

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: Side gutter at 768px and wider. Phones use max(16px, safe-area-inset).

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover nudges: ledger arrow, link underline thickness.

tokens.name: duration-draw
tokens.usage: Terrace lines drawing in on first load, 80ms stagger per line.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: The open-to-work dot ring. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.
